description: Cable colour manager: it holds a list of named colours with key mappings, sets the colour the next cable will be drawn in, and can replace colours across the whole patch
notes: the module has no jacks and no knobs; the whole of it is the colour list on the panel, which is a display rather than a control, so nothing on it can be clicked for a help line
clicking a colour in the list selects it for the next cable; right-clicking one opens its own menu, where it can be renamed, recoloured or given a key mapping
the colour list is stored with the patch, while collections of lists are stored with the plugin and can be recalled from the Collections menu
menu: Replace patch cable colors — swaps one colour for another across every cable in the patch, or replaces them all at once, with an option to pick at random from the list
Collections — saves and recalls whole colour lists, sets which one new copies of the module start with, and resets the saved list back to the one the plugin ships
Add new color — adds a colour to the end of the list
Delete all colors — empties the list
Emblem location — overrides the plugin-wide setting for where this module's emblem is drawn
Color list glows in the dark — overrides the plugin-wide setting for whether the list stays lit when the room lights are off
